hook: Ellsworth graduated early from Stanford with a B.S. in Computer Science with Distinction, worked as a research engineer at Google DeepMind, and now leads initiatives related to search and agents as a Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI. He was a U.S. Presidential Scholar and a USA Biology Olympiad national finalist.
name: Will Ellsworth

quote.text: Graduated early from Stanford University with a B.S. in Computer Science and now doing fun AI stuff.

reading.body:
Will Ellsworth moved from Google DeepMind to OpenAI in 2024 and now leads search and agent initiatives as a Member of Technical Staff, following early graduation from Stanford with a B.S. in Computer Science with Distinction.

His trajectory, from Presidential Scholar to Biology Olympiad finalist to research engineer to agent work, reflects a pattern common among the researchers shaping AI's most compute-intensive capabilities. Search and agents are among the workloads driving demand for larger inference infrastructure, though the data here covers Ellsworth's roles and credentials rather than any specifics of the systems he builds or the resources they consume.

What the record does not include is his M.S. work in detail, the scope of his DeepMind projects, or any technical output such as papers or patents. His LinkedIn summary, the sole primary source, is brief by design. Readers wanting depth on his research contributions will need to look beyond what is available here.
